text:
clara: Postmortem follow-up for the 00:15 UTC incident — cron retry storm generated a flood of low-severity pages that bypassed dedupe. Dropping owners and short actions here.

clara: Summary: a transient DB glitch caused the backfill controller to retry many jobs concurrently, creating hundreds of P4 alerts. Existing dedupe keyed on request_id which changed per retry, so duplicates didn't collapse. Routing rules also had a legacy mapping that paged global-sre instead of queue owners.

clara: Action items (owners + target dates):
- ben -> adjust alert thresholds and add derivative/rate check for backfill jobs (target: Thu EOD)
- yusuf -> dedupe fingerprint change: include job_name + backoff_bucket, extend window to 20m (target: Mon)
- hana -> routing update so queue.* alerts go to queue-owner; soft page to global-sre after 35m (target: Fri)
- diego -> runbook + suppression flag for scheduled windows; require job_label or maintenance_tag (target: Fri)

ben: taking thresholds. First pass: raise latency cutoff for backfills 30s -> 180s and add a slope rule to catch sustained ramps. Will baseline 3d of metrics this morning.

yusuf: dedupe plan: switch to fingerprint = hash(job_name, cluster, error_signature) and set dedupe_window=20m. Will open PR and test in staging with replay.

hana: routing changes: update routing-config mapping and create a canary for queue-east. soft page to global-sre after 35m; no phone calls until 60m.

diego: runbook will include a suppression rule for scheduled windows and a manual override. Draft suppression snippet below for review:
```json
{"name":"scheduled-window-suppress","match":"job_label==\"scheduled_backfill\" && severity==\"P4\"","suppress_for_minutes":360,"notify_channel":"#obs-ops"}
```

oncall-bot: ticket created PM-9022 "Cron retry storm: alert tuning + dedupe" assigned to @ben @yusuf @hana @diego — https://issues.redwood.example/PM-9022

clara: Please post a one-line update here when you have progress so I can roll up at the ops sync. Also adding a small eval job to Redwood Optimize to ensure we don't hide real regressions after thresholds change.

ben: status: collected 72h of metrics; 95p latency for backfill = 132s. proposing threshold=210s + derivative alert. will open PR by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

yusuf: status: PR #501 opened in observability; replay in staging shows ~88% reduction in duplicates. :construction:

hana: status: routing PR drafted and reviewed with queue-east lead; canary scheduled Fri 01:00 UTC. fallback behavior included.

diego: status: runbook draft pushed to docs and FF created in flags service. security review requested (cc @clara).

clara: Next steps: if staging looks good, plan prod flip Mon 02:00 UTC. I'll attach the Optimize eval and monitor for false negatives for 48h post-flip.

ben: will add 30 sample traces to the Optimize eval set.

yusuf: if duplicates remain >15% after 1w, we'll revisit grouping and consider adding job_attempt windowing.

diego: once security approves, I'll enable FF in canary and then prod after canary verification.

clara: final: update PM-9022 with canary and prod flip statuses and close the ticket when all owners confirm prod success. Also adding an incident signature (owner: clara) to recurring-incidents so detectors can auto-match this pattern. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
